scope: Controlled HTTP socket fault injection; never claim injected failures came from Noxi.

modes.fixture: All HTTP responses synthetic, loopback only.
modes.live_proxy: Injected faults synthetic; unfaulted responses forwarded unchanged from externally managed Noxi. No server control endpoints.

embedding_adaptive_capacity.injection: First embedding batch of four returns HTTP400/type exceed_context_size_error.
embedding_adaptive_capacity.all_outputs: Finite vectors with expected dimension and exact input count. No truncation. Numeric identity/order is independently qualified by the ingest campaign.

embedding_http_errors.expected: ClientHTTPError exact status; exactly one failing embedding request, no split/retry. Next call on same adapter succeeds.

embedding_invalid_payloads.expected: LLMBackendError, exactly one failing embedding request; no vectors published and next call succeeds.

embedding_single_capacity: One input context error must not retry, split or truncate; next call succeeds.

llm_http_errors.expected: ClientHTTPError exact status; one chat request, no hidden retry; diagnostics exclude prompt/body/key/path. Next call on same adapter returns RECOVERED with fresh usage.

llm_stream_errors.expected_common: One chat request per failure, no hidden retry; get_last_usage is None and terminal backend_error. Same adapter then succeeds and has fresh usage.

missing_usage: Completed response without usage keeps usage unknown; following normal response has fresh usage.
injected_timeouts: LLM stream and embedding responses deliberately delayed0.2seconds: timeout0.04seconds yields typed LLMTimeoutError with no hidden retry; next call on same adapter succeeds with fresh state. Late synthetic response cannot overwrite fresh usage. This does not prove remote inference cancellation.
selected_model_guard: Every chat request must carry the exact selected LLM alias; embedding/tokenize bodies and props query must carry the exact selected embedding alias. Missing, changed or duplicate props aliases are rejected before upstream forwarding and fail the campaign. Fixture-only self-test exercises nine rejected and four accepted route/model combinations with loopback upstream.
